The important idea is product-aware quantization: the transform is designed using both the cached tensor and the computation that consumes it. This is relevant to cache-aware long-context modeling, KV compression during training or distillation, and any architecture where the error metric should be tied to attention computation rather than raw vector reconstruction.","technical_approach":"WUSH-KV adapts the WUSH transform to KV caches. WUSH builds a closed-form invertible transform from the Gram matrix of the quantized factor and a Hessian induced by the other factor in a matrix product. For KV cache, the method builds separate transforms for keys and values. The key transform uses calibration statistics of keys and sensitivity from the query heads that consume them. The value transform uses value statistics and sensitivity from the output-projection blocks. The value-side transform can be folded into model weights, so it adds no online transform cost. The key-side transform and query compensation are applied after headwise normalization, when present, and after RoPE, matching the actual attention-score path. The transform is independent of the scalar quantizer and can be paired with clipped per-token quantizers. The method also keeps sink and recent cache entries in full precision to avoid damaging positions that carry disproportionate attention mass.","experiments":"The reported experiments show lower layerwise attention reconstruction error and lower perplexity than existing KV-cache quantization methods. The theoretical analysis focuses on QuEST INT and shows near-optimality of the ideal WUSH transform under an additive rounding-noise model plus assumptions on normalized tails and clipping errors. This distinction exposes hidden costs in block-sparse attention, hybrid linear/full attention, and length extrapolation recipes that may look acceptable under low-complexity benchmarks.","technical_approach":"The central concept is Corpus Task Complexity, or CTC. A corpus is treated as an unstructured set of N documents. The authors define task complexity through the number of calls needed to an oracle that can solve only constant-size local subproblems. A fact retrieval task can often be solved by checking each document once, giving O(N) complexity. A contradiction-finding task may require comparing document or claim pairs, giving O(N^2) complexity. This shifts the evaluation question from token length alone to the amount of cross-document interaction required. The authors survey 12 commonly used corpus reasoning tasks and classify them as low-CTC. They then introduce CTC-Bench with 10 high-CTC tasks, including contradiction detection, rare-topic identification, and outlier-style corpus analysis.","experiments":"The benchmark evaluates long-context language models over corpus sizes from 2K to 32K tokens. The main empirical pattern is that performance degrades faster on high-CTC tasks than on low-CTC tasks as the corpus grows. More importantly, high-CTC tasks often change the conclusions one would draw from low-CTC evaluation alone. Block-sparse attention shows little degradation on low-CTC tasks but suffers much larger drops relative to full attention on high-CTC tasks. Similar issues appear for hybrid architectures that alternate linear and full attention, and for length generalization where a model is fine-tuned on shorter contexts than the intended test length. The key reported scale details are 12 analyzed existing tasks, 10 newly introduced high-CTC tasks, and a 2K–32K token evaluation range.","reading_guide":"Read this one carefully. certification split。proposal split 为每个候选 policy 提出一个候选 floor c_k；certification split 对每个候选执行精确二项检验，检验原假设 H_k: P(S_k < c_k) ≥ α。如果能够拒绝，就说明该 candidate 的 α lower-tail quantile 至少不低于这个 floor。然后使用 Holm step-down procedure 控制 family-wise error rate 在 δ 内。最终只在被认证集合中选择 c_k 最大的 candidate；如果没有任何 floor 超过预设 operating threshold，则 abstain。它允许同一个 evaluation unit 上不同 candidates 的得分任意相关，只要求 evaluation units 之间 i.i.d.。相对 Bonferroni，Holm 在同一 proposal 下有逐数据集的优势；相对 exact COPS，二者认证的统计对象不同，所以没有统一支配关系。一个重要设计是把 score map s_k 固定下来，理论只保证 score distribution 的 lower quantile，不要求 score 是无偏估计、正态近似或均值 OPE estimator。","experiments":"论文声明在 24 个预先定义的配置、11 个 benchmark、5 个领域上做 NLP-first evaluation，并使用五模型 jury 与两个 held-out shadow judges。实验目标不是只比较平均分，而是比较不同选择规则能否在低尾 floor 上给出更有用的证书，同时审计 proxy score 和外部 judge 之间的差距。文中还包含 offline RL control study，使用 clipped trajectory-level doubly robust return score；由于 importance ratio clipping 会改变被认证对象，作者单独讨论 score-level certificate 如何转移到 deployment return。正文给出的关键信息是：StepCOPS 在 matched-proposal 条件下统一优于 Bonferroni certificate，但不声称统一优于 exact COPS；proxy-to-return 的转移需要额外假设，并通过 no-overlap 构造说明仅靠 logged data 一般不能得到非平凡 return floor。","reading_guide":"建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Problem Setup，确认它要认证的是 score lower quantile，而不是线上真实 return。然后看 StepCOPS 算法和 Theorem 4，重点理解 proposal/certification split、exact binomial Repeated generations on the same benchmark item produce different binary outcomes, so the benchmark score is an estimate of expected performance. Uniformly repeating every item ignores the fact that item-level rollout variances differ: items with pass probability near 0.5 are noisy, while items near 0 or 1 need fewer samples.","importance":"This is an evaluation-method paper with practical relevance to pretraining and post-training loops. Checkpoint selection, RL iteration, agent workflow search, and automated research systems all depend on repeated evaluations. If rollout noise is large, small but real improvements can be missed, and noisy non-improvements can be selected. The contribution is a statistically better allocation of the same generation budget, yielding tighter estimates without changing the benchmark or model.","technical_approach":"The method, Speculative Evaluation, uses a Hierarchical Bayesian Neyman policy. For item i with pass probability p_i, the rollout variance is p_i(1-p_i). Classical Neyman allocation would assign more samples to higher-variance items if these variances were known. HBN handles the unknown-variance case with a two-stage design. It first runs a small uniform pilot over all tasks, fits a hierarchical Bayesian model to pool noisy success counts, and uses posterior expected sampling variances as allocation scores. It then performs exact positive-integer Neyman allocation for the remaining budget while keeping at least one fresh continuation sample per task. Pilot size and stage weight are chosen before evaluation, and a weighted estimator reuses the pilot without bias. Position bias, transitivity violations, and pairwise agreement treat all comparisons equally, while Bradley–Terry ranking geometry says that close pairs and far-apart pairs have very different effects on recovered rankings. Close pairs are near coin flips; far pairs carry most of the ranking signal.","importance":"The main relevance to foundation-model work is evaluation infrastructure. LLM judges are now used for model selection, preference-data filtering, reward construction, and benchmark aggregation. If reliability metrics are dominated by close-rank-gap pairs, they can penalize judges for uncertainty that has little ranking cost, while missing errors on easy high-gap comparisons that do damage the final ordering. The practical implication is to report judge reliability by pair difficulty or rank gap, rather than relying on aggregate pairwise agreement or raw position-bias rates.","technical_approach":"The analysis uses the Bradley–Terry model. Each item has a latent strength θ, and the probability that item i beats item j is σ(θ_i - θ_j). For a pair with gap Δ, the two possible outcomes differ in log-likelihood by |Δ|. A flipped verdict on a close pair is almost free under the model and barely moves the maximum-likelihood ranking. A flipped verdict on a far pair has a large likelihood cost and pulls the recovered strengths in the wrong direction. This gives a common explanation for run-to-run inconsistency, position bias, and judge-human disagreement. The contribution is not a new judge model, but a reframing of reliability metrics around ranking impact.","experiments":"The controlled simulation fixes pairwise agreement with human labels at 60% and varies only where judge errors occur along the rank-gap spectrum. Judges with the same average agreement produce very different ranking correlations: errors concentrated on large-gap pairs sharply degrade agreement with the gold ranking, while errors on close pairs have much lower cost. The empirical section then studies real pairwise-evaluation data, including 200 texts from the Clear comprehensibility dataset and ASAP 2.0 student-writing data. The experiments stratify inconsistency, position bias, and judge-human disagreement by pair gap, showing that aggregate reliability proxies correlate weakly with human-derived ranking accuracy, while the far-gap tail contains more predictive signal.","reading_guide":"A useful skim takes about 20–30 minutes. 标注、支持证据和构造式推理链，但模型答对题，并不等于它真的依赖了这些中间证据。模型可能靠参数记忆、未标注的更短路径、表面线索，甚至局部证据就把答案猜出来。论文用行为干预的方式把这个问题形式化：如果删掉某一跳对应的证据，模型还能答对，那么这一步对该模型并不“行为上必要”。核心问题因此是，如何把“有标注的推理结构”与“模型实际依赖该结构作答”区分开，并据此构造更有诊断性的多跳评测集。","importance":"对基座模型研究的直接价值不在于提出了新的训练方法，而在于它把一个长期被默认接受的评测前提拆开了：answer accuracy 不能直接当作 compositional reasoning 的证据。这个结论对长上下文预训练、检索增强、reasoning data 合成、以及 post-train 阶段的推理能力评估都很重要。若 benchmark 本身允许大量 shortcut，模型在其上的提升就很难解释为“推理能力提升”。这篇工作的贡献量级主要体现在评测方法学：一是提出了可操作的行为审计指标 BNR：只在模型原本答对的样本上统计，随机抽取一个标注 hop 或 support group，删除其对应证据后，如果模型不能再恢复正确答案，则记为该证据对该模型是行为必要的。为了避免“删文本本身就让题更难”这种非特异性影响，作者还设计了 matched-background control，用背景删除对照来分离 evidence-specific failure 和 generic deletion sensitivity。这个设计比单看 accuracy drop 更干净，因为它关心的是‘删掉被宣称必要的那部分证据后，失败是否显著高于删掉长度和位置匹配但语义无关的背景文本’。\n\n第二部分是 RealHop 数据构造框架。它不是简单加 distractor，而是围绕“让每一步都不可绕过”来重写问题与上下文。具体包括三类操作：1）entity verification 分离：先通过结构和语义检查筛样本，冻结数据后，再做 targeted deletion 审计，避免边构造边调 benchmark 到某个模型上。对没有原生 hop 标注的数据，如 FRAMES，作者通过 source-linked evidence 重新建立可干预的支持单元。对 LongBench v2，则进一步把长文档任务改造成可审计的 multiple-choice multi-hop reasoning itself. It asks a more basic question: do current multi-hop benchmarks actually measure dependence on the intended reasoning chain? Existing datasets often provide annotated hops and supporting evidence, and correct answers are commonly treated as evidence that the model composed those steps. The paper shows that this inference is weak. A model may answer correctly via memorized associations, an unannotated shorter path, partial evidence, or superficial cues. The core problem is therefore to separate annotated reasoning structure from behavioral reliance on that structure, and to build benchmarks where each intended step is genuinely necessary for successful answering.","importance":"Its main contribution is methodological rather than algorithmic. For pretraining and foundation-model research, this matters because many claims about reasoning, long-context understanding, retrieval use, or synthetic reasoning data rely on benchmark scores whose diagnostic validity is often assumed rather than tested. The paper argues that answer accuracy alone is not sufficient evidence of compositional reasoning. It contributes a behavioral auditing metric, BNR, and a benchmark construction pipeline, RealHop, that makes evidence necessity measurable and enforceable. The practical impact is that benchmark scores become more interpretable, and model differences become more separable once shortcut paths are removed.","technical_approach":"$7e","experiments":"$7f","reading_guide":"For a skim-level read, start with the introduction and problem formulation. 组织的结构化计划，覆盖场景、主体、动作、镜头语言、光照、音频/对白以及跨 shot 的叙事推进。它解决的是多因素耦合问题：动作变化会影响镜头运动，镜头运动又会影响节奏和转场，不能像普通 prompt rewrite 那样只做局部修饰。\n\n在 SFT 之后，作者引入 SC-GRPO。这里的重点不是 GRPO 本身，而是 reward 的设计。论文给了一个九维 semantic consistency reward，用来检查用户需求是否在整个计划中被完整保留，尤其关注四类错误：需求遗漏、语义篡改、实体/属性/动作绑定错误、时间顺序和跨镜头一致性冲突。相比只看最终文本质量或流畅度，这种 reward 更接近 structured fidelity。它的作用类似在长序列生成里加入一个全局 This is relevant for SFT and RL data design, especially when length penalties risk compressing reasoning too aggressively.","technical_approach":"The method, ConfSFT, first collects reasoning trajectories from the model itself. At selected intermediate states, a fixed answer-elicitation prompt is appended, and the model greedily produces a trial answer. Confidence is defined as the geometric mean of the token probabilities assigned to that trial answer, i.e. a length-normalized likelihood under the model’s own distribution. It does not require gold labels or an external judge, and it is not treated as a calibrated probability of correctness. Fine-tuning examples then train the model to predict this confidence from the intermediate reasoning state. Reasoning tokens are masked out of the loss; only the confidence target is supervised. At inference time, generation is unchanged: no confidence query, no early-stopping controller, and no special decoding rule.","experiments":"The training set contains only about 600 problems. The motivating analysis uses 480 Nemotron traces on AIME 2024, with 16 samples per problem, and evaluates confidence at intermediate states. Higher confidence correlates with higher trial-answer correctness and stronger agreement with the eventual final answer. The expected gain from continuing to reason drops sharply as confidence increases. Even after first reaching c_t >= 0.95, Nemotron still generates a median of 1,766 additional tokens, with many traces continuing for more than 10K tokens. ConfSFT reduces generated tokens by up to about 25% at matched accuracy across four model families, and the effect transfers from math training problems to science and coding tasks. Ablations show that shuffled confidence labels and alternative targets provide weaker or no efficiency gains. exp(ε))。这样就能看到，同样大小的 ε 在低置信 token 上会把 ratio 推得很远，在高置信 token 上影响较小。固定 ratio cap 因此会更多裁掉低置信 token，偏差集中在这些位置。CIS 反过来裁剪 ε，而不是直接裁剪 r。论文的经验观察是 ε 的分布随 token confidence 变化不大，因此可以用一个统一阈值识别异常 displacement。映射回 ratio 后，这等价于一个随置信度变化的 ratio cap：token 越高置信，允许的 ratio 上限越紧。理论部分证明，CIS 可以控制 exact importance correction 中容易爆炸的二阶矩项，代价是由被截断 excess 决定的偏差。","experiments":"实验覆盖三个 MoE 模型和五个数学推理 benchmark，任务背景是 Rollouts are produced by an inference engine such as vLLM or SGLang, while gradients are computed by a separate training engine such as FSDP or Megatron. Even with identical weights, the two engines may assign different probabilities to the same sampled token because of kernel implementations, reduction order, precision, and MoE routing differences. For a query x and prior history C, the writer produces query-conditioned textual memory M containing relevant evidence, temporal relations, and derived facts. A compressor encodes M through the first four blocks of a frozen backbone and maps it into K continuous vectors Z. The reader generates responses conditioned on x and Z. During on-policy training, the student samples a response under soft memory. A frozen teacher, initialized from the same reader but conditioned on textual memory M, scores the identical token sequence. Token-level log-probability gaps reveal positions where the textual-memory reader is more confident than the compressed-memory reader. A small language model is fit to the data from round t−1 and then used to score both round t−1 and round t data with negative log-likelihood. If the new round has higher NLL under the previous-round model, it contains content that the previous distribution does not explain. Under an exact distributional fit, the quantity decomposes into KL divergence between the two round distributions plus the change in entropy. This separates distribution shift from diversity change. The proposed ATRI module uses the signal in two ways: within a round, samples with above-average information gain receive larger weights; across rounds, training stops when the gain remains below a threshold for consecutive rounds.","experiments":"The paper reports evaluations on several common self-evolution datasets and compares ATRI against filtering- and regularization-based baselines. The UMM has a generator G and an understanding branch U. Starting from an image, U proposes several textual descriptions. Candidates are filtered for consistency with the source image, so the solver is challenged by valid rather than corrupted examples. G then attempts each admitted description several times, and attempts are scored by image-text agreement and consistency with the original source. The candidate with the lowest mean solver score becomes the challenge, and the solver is updated with GRPO on its sampled attempts. The same procedure runs in the opposite direction from text to images. The main difference from adversarial training with a discriminator is that no extra adversary is trained. The adversary is a pool of selected model outputs. 的条件概率变化。这样可以避免“换图后模型生成了另一条轨迹”带来的混杂因素。作者定义 EFS 来度量图像干预对 claim token 预测分布的影响强度；如果模型真的在用视觉证据，EFS 应该上升。但仅有 EFS 不够，因为整条轨迹在换图后可能出现全局 likelihood 漂移，所以作者又定义 claim persistence，并用同一 rollout 中的 residual tokens 做校准，试图扣除轨迹级别的整体分布变化，专门看“这个 claim 自身是否仍被支持”。这一步是论文最关键的分析设计，因为它把“视觉敏感”与“视觉可撤回”分开了。\n\n在此基础上，作者提出 Persistence-Aware Credit Gating，简称 PACG。训练时先识别 routed direct visual claims，也就是那些被判定为直接依赖视觉证据的 token span。对于正 advantage 的 token，如果对应 claim 在反事实图像下能明显 retract，就保留完整正信用；如果 claim 异常 persistent，即证据被破坏后仍维持高支持度，则衰减其正信用。负 advantage token 和非 routed token 不做改动。这样设计很克制：它不直接惩罚所有视觉 token，也不需要 claim 的人工真值标签，只是在“本来会被奖励”的位置上做选择性减弱。作者强调 PACG 可组合到 DAPO、VPPO 这类现有 RLVR 优化器上，而且没有推理时额外开销。\n\n和已有 perception reward、token reweighting、multimodal PRM 的区别在于，这篇工作不主要问“哪些 token 看了图”，而是问“这些 token 排序候选轨迹，而不是直接按原始 staleness 丢弃。分数由 Waiting Staleness 加上加权后的 Generation Staleness 构成。Waiting Staleness 被完整保留，因为它主要来自 pool 中可避免的排队。Generation Staleness 则乘以由 Prefix Forgetting Score 映射得到的权重。Prefix Forgetting Score 衡量当前策略相对生成策略在前缀 token log-probability 上的漂移，用来区分“只是生成时间长”与“策略已经忘掉这段前缀”。这样做可以减少一个常见偏差：长轨迹、难题更容易有高 generation lag，如果直接按 lag 丢弃，会把训练集推向短而容易的样本。","experiments":"实验在六个数学推理 benchmark 上比较同步 的平均准确率提升。结果说明，简单异步虽然提高资源重叠，但 staleness 会明显损伤学习；只要在 pool 层过滤掉有效滞后最高的 surplus trajectories，可以保留异步吞吐的大部分收益，同时接近或略好于同步训练的最终质量。","reading_guide":"建议泛读，预计 25–40 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对异步 RL 训练瓶颈和 staleness LLM post-training. As rollout workers generate trajectories while the trainer keeps updating the policy, completed samples may be trained under a policy that is several versions ahead of the behavior policy. The key decomposition is into Generation Staleness, accumulated before a trajectory finishes, and Waiting Staleness, accumulated while completed trajectories sit in the pool. The practical question is how many completed trajectories to reject and which ones, under a fixed allocation of rollout and trainer resources.","importance":"The paper is most relevant to the systems side of RL post-training, especially for long-horizon reasoning where rollout cost dominates. It does not change the pretraining objective, but it gives a useful lens on training-signal freshness. Instead of treating staleness as a single version gap, it separates unavoidable generation delay from avoidable pool waiting, then uses queue pressure as a control signal. This is a useful complement to importance-weight correction and fixed lag windows. For foundation-model training, the broader lesson is that sample quality also depends on when a trajectory reaches the optimizer, not only on the reward or prompt distribution.","technical_approach":"PACE, or Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness, operates at the completed-trajectory pool. Pool occupancy determines an adaptive rejection budget: if the pool is overfilled, PACE rejects more surplus trajectories; if ready data is scarce, it relaxes rejection to avoid starving the trainer. Candidate trajectories are ranked by an effective staleness score rather than raw lag. The score keeps Waiting Staleness in full and adds Generation Staleness weighted by a Prefix Forgetting Score. This prefix score measures drift in prefix token log-probabilities between the generation policy and the current policy. 目标与真实更新量更一致。论文里还说明 ACPO 可以无缝嵌入 PPO 和 GRPO 这类框架，而不需要重写整个训练流程。理论部分有两条主线。第一条是二阶矩分析：在显式假设下，ACPO 的梯度估计二阶矩不大于 PPO；在额外假设下，还能推出方差更低。这里的重点不是一个很强的最优性结论，而是给出“为什么裁 rA 比只裁 r 更稳”的形式化解释。第二条是与 policy mirror descent PPO and GRPO clip the ratio, assuming the advantage scale is handled elsewhere. To separate architectural bias from learned behavior, the authors track the phenomenon across pretraining checkpoints, especially using Pythia-style trajectories. This separates two failure modes that are often conflated in practice. A run may fail not because the reward surface is full of traps, but because the policy update cannot diffuse across equal-reward deterministic codes, or because the signal-to-noise ratio is too poor without strong regularization and curriculum. The paper establishes three links: local reward maxima are continuously connected to deterministic policies without crossing a loss barrier; the entropy-regularized RLVR objective is lower-bounded by the free energy of the corresponding spin model; and trapped configurations under local spin dynamics approximately match RLVR fixed points. The task family is iterated group or quasigroup multiplication: the policy receives a sequence of elements, emits one intermediate token per step, and receives reward only when the final product is correct. The first model class is a bounded-window myopic tabular policy, chosen to expose properties of the RLVR objective before adding transformer parameterization effects.","experiments":"The theoretical result is that, for simple untied models with uncorrelated inputs, the reward landscape has no suboptimal local maxima. Numerically, a simple Monte Carlo sampler over the spin model solves the untied tasks without curriculum. In contrast, exact local RLVR policy updates can fail in the same setting, because they do not move effectively across flat equal-reward regions. When weight tying or input correlations are introduced, the proof no longer applies, and local maxima appear in experiments. 的目标错配：若激活可分解为多个概念成分，重构损失对每个成分的奖励近似与其能量 E_j 成正比，因此高方差背景概念比低方差 forget 概念更容易被模型优先编码。这个分析不是严格现实假设下的定理，而是一个足够解释经验现象的 incentive model。\n\n基于这个问题，SCALPEL 不再只做重构，而是在 SAE 上加入针对 forget target 的对比学习。具体做法是：以 forget anchor 为中心，构造多个 paraphrase 和 rewrite 视图，把同一 anchor 的不同视图当正样本；负样本不从其他 forget 样本里取，而是从 retain 数据里取。这样做有两个目的。其一，不把 forget 集内部相关样本彼此推开，避免把目标概念自己打散。其二，把目标稳定出现的成分从共享语言模式、任务模式和背景语义里拉出来。训练完成后，SAE 给出一组固定的 sparse features，推理时对每个输入先经 encoder 判断哪些 forget features 被激活，再按强度减去对应 decoder 方向，形成输入相关的表示过滤。\n\n论文还有两个细节值得注意。第一，作者提出了 norm-aware feature selection，不只看 encoder activation，也看 decoder direction 的范数，因为真正的干预强度取决于“激活多少”和“沿哪个方向减去多少”。第二，理论部分给了三层论证：重构目标的 energy bias、加入 contrastive term 后更偏向 target-selective sparse representation、以及高分特征对背景扰动存在上界。这些理论更像方法合理性的支撑，而不是严格保证。","experiments":"实验在 TOFU 的 保真、特征选择性和重学/绕过风险。\n\n关键结果可以概括为四类。第一，在表示提取层面，SCALPEL 学到的特征比 reconstruction-only 方法更集中于 forget target，对 retain 数据的误伤更小。作者用背景激活投影、特征打分和可视化说明，标准 PCA/SAE 更容易吸收高能量背景结构，而 SCALPEL 提取的方向更贴近目标作者痕迹。第二，在 The proposed attack keeps generating additional reasoning paths and strategically reorders the disclosed sequence. When an auditor replays the provider’s stopping rule on that sequence, the process appears not to have been able to stop earlier, making the inflated path count look justified. The paper proves that, under natural count-based stopping rules, the attack can add a nontrivial number of generations and provides a lower bound on the expected number of extra samples. of a pre-execution decision. The central issue is that in a multi-action setting, moving the model away from a wrong action does not guarantee that it moves to the correct action, nor that it preserves decisions that were already correct.","importance":"The paper is not a pretraining-method contribution, but it is relevant to agentic post-training and mechanistic evaluation. It argues that tool-use failures should be modeled as directional error channels, such as correct-action-to-baseline-action pairs, rather than as a binary tool/no-tool mistake. This matters for SFT, RL, and representation-level control because aggregate accuracy can hide collateral damage and error redistribution. The work is also a useful caution: linear decodability of an internal state does not imply reliable steerability.","technical_approach":"The proposed framework, SAKIKO, treats representation repair as an evidence pipeline. It includes directional error discovery, per-input detection of channel-associated states, router-conditioned intervention, destination-resolved verification over the full K-way action space, and statistical licensing under pre-specified rules. The action space includes direct response, API/tool call, clarification request, and task declination. An error channel is represented as an ordered pair c = y* → ŷ0, where y* is the reference action and ŷ0 is the frozen model’s baseline action. Interventions are keyed to channels and applied only when the router fires. The important methodological choice is to verify the destination of the intervention, not just whether the original error disappeared. The framework also checks whether the intervention corrupts examples that were originally correct.","experiments":"The experiments cover seven LLMs across five model families, using tool-decision benchmarks including When2Call and MetaTool. ","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"","category_id":"agent","cover_url":"/covers/2609_37743.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是长程 agent 执行里的一个具体但常被低估的问题：历史上下文不是越多越好，也不是只靠 recency 或语义相关性就能裁剪好。真正困难的地方在于，早先某次 tool 调用产出的局部信息，可能在很多步之后以变量、标识符、参数、约束条件等形式再次被复用；如果中间被压缩掉，模型当前这一步虽然看起来“语义上不太相关”，但执行上已经失去关键依赖。论文要解决的，就是如何在固定 history budget 下，把这类对后续执行仍有支撑作用的完整 tool result 保留下来，同时避免把整段历史都塞回上下文。","importance":"它对基座预训练不是直接方法贡献，更像是对 agent-time context management 的一项执行层改进，所以定级为 skim 是合适的。但它有两个启发点。第一，它把“上下文价值”从静态文本相关性，推进到“执行依赖中的可观测复用”，这对长上下文训练、memory 建模、tool-augmented pretrain 都有参考意义。第二，它说明很多 agent 失败并不是推理能力不够，而是历史状态表示不对；如果以后做原生 tool-use pretraining，可能需要把 execution dependency 作为训练信号，而不只是把轨迹串成纯文本。换句话说，这篇文章更像是在提醒：对 agent 来说，context 是程序状态的一部分，不只是 prompt。","technical_approach":"方法由三部分组成。第一是 persistent context graph。系统不把历史仅仅存成线性消息序列，而是把 message、tool call、tool result 作为节点持久化保存，同时保留时间顺序和引用关系。这样做的目的，是让“当前没放进上下文”的结果也不会丢失，后面还能被重新取回。\n\n第二是 Tool-Flow Analysis，简称 TFA。这是文章最关键的部分。它分析后续模型步骤和 tool 调用里出现的值，追踪这些值最早由哪个 tool result 引入，再把这种从早期结果到后续操作的连接记录成 observed reuse。这里的信号不是模型预测的 importance，而是执行过程中已经发生过的复用证据。论文强调，很多真正重要的信息并不一定在当前 query 上语义最相近，但如果它在执行链条里被多次引用，就应该提高保留优先级。这个设计和常见 retrieval memory 的差别在于：后者主要看当前查询与历史片段的匹配，前者额外利用了执行轨迹里的因果痕迹。\n\n第三是 renderer。每次模型调用前，renderer 在固定 token budget 内选择哪些历史 tool result 以完整形式放回上下文。打分信号由三类组成：observed reuse、recency、semantic relevance。未被选中的结果不会被删除，只是暂时不显示，仍保留在 graph 中供后续恢复。这个设计比一次性 summary 更稳，因为 summary 往往会丢掉后面才知道重要的细节。\n\n从方法取舍看，这篇工作没有走“让模型自己决定怎么压缩”的路线，也没有做复杂的 learned memory controller，而是用显式结构化状态和规则化信号来管理上下文。这样做的优点是可解释、可恢复、部署简单；代价是 TFA 对值流追踪的覆盖率和鲁棒性会决定上限，尤其当复用不是字面值级别，而是抽象语义级别时，信号可能不完整。","experiments":"实验在两个 benchmark 上做：AppWorld，以及 8-objective QA；执行模型用了三种。论文主结果集中在一个 primary 6K history budget 设定，也就是给 agent 先前执行历史分配 6K token 左右的可见预算，而不是把全部累计历史都传入。结论是，ContextRender 在这个较小预算下，任务表现接近甚至有时超过 full-history，同时相对 full-history 的平均标准化推理成本下降 10.2% 到 32.2%。\n\n和多种 managed-context baseline 相比，它在两个 The key idea is to separate immediate usefulness from persistent trust. A rule extracted from the current episode can guide the rest of that episode, but it must pass prospective validation in later episodes before it becomes retrievable long-term knowledge. This is a cleaner interface than standard reflection or trajectory memory, which often waits until an output or episode is complete before updating memory.","technical_approach":"StepLearn is a nonparametric framework with fixed actor and auxiliary learner parameters. Each turn yields a transition consisting of the current observation, selected action, next observation, and optional feedback. From informative transitions, the learner extracts a hypothesis with three fields: an applicability condition, a policy, and an expected effect. The hypothesis is split into two copies. A runtime copy is available immediately from the next step within the same episode. A candidate copy is stored but cannot guide future episodes until it is validated. During validation, compatible hidden candidates register predictions before the agent acts; later observations provide evidence for or against the predicted effect. The source episode is excluded, and each later episode contributes at most one conclusive verdict per item. Candidates with enough support and predictive precision are promoted to verified memory. This turns sparse task feedback into testable intermediate predictions.","experiments":"The paper evaluates over five rounds on WebArena-Lite and ALFWorld. homophily，以及全局层面的 community partition。实验日志里，每轮每个 agent 都会先做一个可观察决策，再把该决策和简短消息发给若干同伴。作者据此构造一个有向加权 agreement graph：如果 agent i 联系了 agent j，而 j 下一轮的 commitment 与 i 发给它的 commitment 一致，就在 i→j 上累积权重。权重按被联系轮次归一化，避免“联系更多”或“更晚收敛”带来伪信号。然后再看图上的社区结构是否与标签对齐，同时单独测同标签之间是否存在更高的正向互动概率。\n\n第二，实验设计上用了很干净的 counterfactual。固定 agent 实例和任务，只改 agent 可见的标签条件：真实 family label、打乱后的 family The answer is yes. Visible identity labels induce stable label-aligned grouping behavior, which the paper calls factionalism. The definition has two parts: local homophily, where agents preferentially direct positive interaction toward same-label peers, and global partitioning, where the interaction graph splits into communities aligned with those labels. The key result is that this effect does not require task incentives, personas, or even true architectural differences. Instead of compressing parameter-space momentum after the fact, BOM stores history in output or task space and reprojects it through the current model. If the trade-off holds at scale, it can reduce optimizer state and checkpoint footprint while offering a different interpretation of momentum: keep the stable prediction-error signal, not necessarily the old parameter-space vector.","technical_approach":"Backpropagated Output Momentum maintains an exponential moving average of batch-mean output residuals, q_t, rather than a dense first-moment tensor for every parameter. The paper decomposes the batch gradient into a batch-mean Jacobian times a batch-mean residual, plus a within-batch covariance term between example-specific Jacobians and residuals. AdamW averages the already projected parameter-space gradients. BOM averages residuals in task space and maps the accumulated history back through the current batch-mean Jacobian. The current supervised gradient is still computed normally; BOM replaces the historical first-moment component. The second moment remains parameter-local, since elementwise squaring does not commute with the vector-Jacobian map. The method is designed as a plug-in for AdamW, Adam-mini, and GaLore, while leaving their adaptive scaling rules intact.","experiments":"The experiments include NLP fine-tuning across three backbones and three optimizer compositions, where five-task macro scores improve consistently according to the paper. On RoBERTa-base, BOM reduces optimizer state and peak memory across the AdamW, Adam-mini, and GaLore variants. The reported reduction in parameter-shaped optimizer state is 49.7% to 99.8%. The pretraining measurements focus on training-checkpoint savings and a calibrated cost model for the compute-memory trade-off. The paper also probes historical-projection drift and uses matched temporal-kernel and own-step controls to support the claim that current reprojection contributes beyond a simple change in smoothing.","reading_guide":"Skim to semi-close read in 30–45 minutes. improve uniformly. The central issue is task structure. A team behaves differently when success depends on one member finding the right discrete answer than when success depends on averaging continuous estimates. Voting, pass@N, revision, and averaging have different statistical limits, so a single team-size scaling story is misleading.","importance":"The contribution is not a pretraining method, but it is useful for researchers working on test-time compute and model-output distributions. If item-level bias dominates, averaging does little. These observations matter for designing self-consistency, debate data, verifiers, and evaluations of whether models provide genuinely diverse hypotheses.","technical_approach":"The authors use Steiner’s taxonomy of group tasks as the organizing frame. They focus on disjunctive tasks, such as QA and math problems where the team may succeed if one member is correct or if voting/verifier selection picks the right answer, and compensatory tasks, such as Fermi estimates where the team output is an average. They model independently sampled agents as conditionally independent given the item. Under this model, plurality voting converges to the model’s item-level modal answer, while averaging converges to the model’s item-level bias. This separates two mechanisms that are often conflated: the probability that the correct answer appears somewhere in the sample set, and the probability that aggregation selects it.","experiments":"The study evaluates 13 open-weight models with teams of up to 30 agents. Plurality voting, however, is tightly bounded by the modal-answer limit; the conditional-independence model predicts large-team voting accuracy within about 0.5 points. Revision rounds improve accuracy, but using one peer gives nearly the same improvement as using 29 peers, suggesting that most of the benefit comes from a single perturbation rather than from scaling the team. On compensatory Fermi-estimation tasks, item-level bias explains about 87% of squared log-error, and averaging reduces error by only about 6%. Existing scaling laws usually model loss as a function of per-modality data counts, such as image count and text count, sometimes with empirical interaction terms. By introducing the pairing fraction p = 2 n_p / (D_1 + D_2) and varying it while holding modality budgets fixed, the paper shows that paired and unpaired data should not be treated as interchangeable.
